call_points.text: Acquired engineering assets of Bhilai Engineering Corporation Limited (BECL) to expand manufacturing floor space and central India presence.
Forged defence technology tie-ups with Fincantieri (naval), FlyFocus (drones), Virtualabs (radars), and Kliver Polska (underwater systems).

operating_notes.text: Company aims to execute a major portion of its ₹2,643.39 Cr order book within 15 months.
Associate Lloyds Infrastructure and Construction Limited holds an order book of ₹5,681.76 Cr.
Proforma group order book stands at ₹8,335.15 Cr across Infrastructure, Engineering, and Electrical segments.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹495.02 Cr (+113.4% YoY), net profit ₹46.49 Cr (+137.8% YoY).
Lloyds Engineering released its FY26 investor presentation highlighting proforma merged revenue of ₹3,253 Cr and an order book of ₹8,335 Cr.
Lloyds Engineering received CCI approval for the merger of Lloyds Infrastructure & Construction, Metalfab Hightech, and Techno Industries into the company.
Lloyds Engineering received BSE and NSE NOCs for the merger scheme involving three group entities.
Mukesh R. Gupta, as Promoter of Lloyds Engineering Works Limited, confirmed no new encumbrances on shares for FY2025-26 beyond prior disclosures on April 6, 2026.
Lloyds Engineering held its court-convened equity shareholders' meeting on October 16, 2026, for the absorption of three group companies.
On October 16, 2026, Lloyds Engineering's unsecured creditors approved the scheme of merger by absorption of three group companies.
